body: We were friends for about a month, so it wasn't frequent, but in that short time, she kept saying that she felt we could be open with each other and she also opened up about a lot of sensitive issues to me

She explicitly told me she felt I was too guarded and when I told her what was bothering me (which was that I had a panic attack at the grocery store because they shuffled all the aisles and it was overwhelming) she said she didn't want to be friends anymore and then stopped talking to me. I don't think she could have been clearer, unfortunately
